description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 99. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. Blocks 0 to 99 have a complete chain with an open and a release. Blocks 200 to 299 have a complete chain too, but it does not intersect the request, so none of its events counts anywhere, whatever their block_number (clause 1): a finalized EscrowOpened with block_number null and an identical copy of it, an unfinalized EscrowRefunded with block_number null, an event with no section, and an EscrowOpened at block 250. Counted, they would have added an open, a duplicate, a pending event and a malformed event. Expected: complete true, status complete; covered 0 to 99; gaps none; totals escrows_opened 1, escrows_released 1, escrows_refunded 0, channels_opened 0, channels_settled 0; pending_unfinalized 0; duplicates_dropped 0; excluded_other_genesis 0; malformed_dropped 0; by_account synthetic-alice (escrows_opened 1, escrows_released 1).
